questions.question: A man invested Rs. 4,400 at 10% and Rs. 7,500 at 8% simple interest. What amount (in Rs.) will he get from his investments after 12 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1st principal (P₁) = Rs.4400

Rate (R₁) = 10% ; Time (T) = 12 years

2nd principal (P₂) = 7500

Rate (R₂) = 8% ; Time (T) = 12 years

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

Where, S.I = simple interest

R = rate% ; T = time

**Calculation:**

Total S.I = (4400 × 10 × 12)/100 + (7500 × 8 × 12)/100

⇒ 440 × 12 + 75 × 96

⇒ 5280 + 7200

⇒ Rs.12480

Total amount = total S.I + total principal

⇒ 12480 + 4400 + 7500

⇒ Rs.24380

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.24380.**

questions.question: Two cities P and Q are 181 km apart on a straight road. One man starts from P at 8:30 A.M. and travels toward Q at 30 km/h. If another man starts from Q at 8:54 A.M. and travels towards P at a speed of 35 km/h, then at what time will they meet?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between cities P and Q = 181 km

Speed of P = 30 km/h

Speed of Q = 35 km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance covered by P in 24 minutes = (30 × 24)/60 = 12 km

Remaining distance between P and Q = 181 - 12 = 169 km

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ 169 = (35 + 30) × time

⇒ Time = 169/65

⇒ Time = 13/5 = 2 hours 36 minutes

Required time = 8 hours 54 minute + 2 hours 36 minutes

⇒ 11 hours 30 minutes 

**∴ The correct answer is 11:30 A.M.**

questions.question: The cost price of an article is 72% of the marked price. The profit percentage after allowing a discount of 6% on the marked price is (rounded off to 2 decimal places):
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (C.P) = 72% marked price (M.P)

Discount% = 6%

**Formula used:**

If discount = D% then

Selling price (S.P) = M.P × (100 - D)%

Profit = S.P - C.P

Profit% = (profit × 100)/C.P 

**Calculation:**

⇒ C.P = 72% × M.P

⇒ C.P/M.P = 72/100

So, C.P = 72 and M.P = 100

Selling price (S.P) = 100 × (100 - 6)%

⇒ 100 × 94% = Rs.94

Profit% = {(94 -72) × 100}/72

⇒ (22 × 100)/72

⇒ 275/9 = 30.55 ≈ 30.56%

**∴ The correct answer is 30.56%.**

questions.question: The sum of the cubes of two given numbers is 10234, while the sum of the two given numbers is 34. What is the positive difference between the cubes of the two given numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum of the cubes of two numbers = 10234

Sum of the two given numbers = 34

**Formula used:**

(a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab × (a + b)

a3 - b3 = (a - b) × (a2 + ab + b2)

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

(a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

**Calculation:**

Let 1st number = a

And second number = b

From question:

a³ + b³ = 10234

and a + b = 34

Using algebraic identity:

⇒ (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab × (a + b)

⇒ (34)³ = 10234 + 3ab × 34

⇒ 39304 = 10234 + 102ab

⇒ 102ab = (39304 - 10234)

⇒ ab = 29070/102 = 285

Now,

⇒ (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ (34)² = a2 + b2 + 2 × 285

⇒ 1156 - 570 = a2 + b2

⇒ a2 + b2 = 586

and

⇒ (a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

⇒ 586 - 2 × 285

⇒ 586 - 570 

⇒ (a - b) = √16 = 4

Putting the required value in the equation:

 

⇒ a³ - b³ = (a - b) × (a² + ab + b²)

⇒ 4 × (586 + 285)

⇒ 4 × 871

⇒ 3484

**∴ The correct answer is 3484.**

questions.question: If Cosec θ - cot θ = (7)/(2), then the value of cosec θ will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If cosec θ − cot θ = x, then cosec θ = (x + 1/x) ÷ 2.

Here, x = 7/2.

⇒ cosec θ = (7/2 + 2/7) ÷ 2

⇒ cosec θ = (49/14 + 4/14) ÷ 2

⇒ cosec θ = (53/14) ÷ 2 = 53/28

**∴ The correct answer is 53/28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

cosec θ − cot θ = 7/2

**Formula Used:**

cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ (cosec θ − cot θ) × (cosec θ + cot θ) = 1

⇒ (7/2) × (cosec θ + cot θ) = 1

⇒ cosec θ + cot θ = 2/7

⇒ Adding the given equation and the derived equation:

⇒ (cosec θ − cot θ) + (cosec θ + cot θ) = 7/2 + 2/7

⇒ 2 × cosec θ = (49 + 4) ÷ 14

⇒ 2 × cosec θ = 53 / 14

⇒ cosec θ = 53 / 28

**∴ The correct answer is 53/28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Core Trigonometric Identities

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 | sec² θ − tan² θ = 1 | cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1.

Secant & Tangent Shortcut Pattern

Similar to the relation between cosec and cot, if sec θ + tan θ = x, then sec θ − tan θ = 1/x. From this, we can easily deduce sec θ = (x + 1/x) ÷ 2.

Reciprocal Functions

cosec θ = 1 ÷ sin θ | sec θ = 1 ÷ cos θ | cot θ = 1 ÷ tan θ.
</p

Increment in population in the years 2011 & 
2012 = 2%

Decrement in population in the year 2013 = 1%

**Concept used:**

If population increment = P% then,

Increased % = population × (100 + P)%

If population decrement = D% then,

Decreased % = population × (100 - D)%

**Calculation:**

Population of city at the end of 2013 = 1250000 × 102% × 102% × 99% 

⇒ 5 × 51 × 51 × 99 = 12,87,495

**∴ The correct answer is 12,87,495.**

In ΔPQR,

⇒ ∠P + 35 + 90 = 180°

⇒ ∠P = 180 - 125 = 55°

⇒ ∠P = ∠A = 55° (∵ ΔABC ≅ ΔPQR)

**∴ The correct answer is 55°.**
